values.note: Book online on Campspot or by phone; extended, monthly and seasonal stays by phone. Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends need 3 nights (not the primitive/tent areas). Campspot showed a 5-night minimum on the Preferred and Deluxe full-hookup sites for a July 2027 Saturday. Short stays need one night's deposit; cancel 7 days ahead (holidays 14) or forfeit it.
